1.t: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Most High,

2.t: who created [all things] in due proportion;

3.t: who determined their destinies and guided them;

4.t: who brought out the green pasture

6.t: [Prophet], We shall teach you [the Quran] and you will not forget––

7.t: unless God wishes; He knows both what is open and what is hidden––

8.t: We shall show you the easy way.

9.t: So remind, if reminding will help.

10.t: Those who stand in awe of God will heed the reminder,

11.t: but it will be ignored by the most wicked,

12.t: who will enter the Great Fire,

13.t: where they will neither die nor live.

14.t: Prosperous are those who purify themselves,

15.t: remember the name of their Lord, and pray.

16.t: Yet you [people] prefer the life of this world,

17.t: even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

18.t: All this is in the earlier scriptures,

19.t: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
